instruction: Enlarge the canvas, fill the new margin with white, and resize all layers to match.

criteria.script: async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: '.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc', format: 'sexpr', key: 'image-resize-fill-type', default: 'transparent' } ] }); return data[0]; }
